title: Add site says it is writing the Customize answers while it does, and a run that did not get them all in keeps the ready screen up to say so
steps: S1: Read the console steps (stepsFrom) of a job that went baseline → "writing your text and pictures" → "placing your text and pictures on the site", for WordPress, Joomla and EmDash.
S2: Read briefOutcomeOf for failed, applied and anything else.
S3: In the real wizard (browser fixture), create a site whose job answers running "writing your text and pictures", then done with briefState failed, the agent up.
expect: S1: two steps of their own after the starting point (step_writing, step_placing), the last one running.
S3: the console shows "Writing your text and pictures"; the ready screen shows [data-brief-outcome="failed"] ("could not finish writing your answers") and the page does not land on the site.
evidence: 16/10/2026 local stand (Joomla, Dutch answers): the console spun "Recording a starting point" for about five minutes while the brief ran; the client never read briefState, and prod incident #1367 landed two customers on half-demo sites with no word
fence: The brief's stage words are console steps; a failed brief stops the automatic landing, as a design system that could not be put on does

tests: the Customize answers being written are a step of their own
the ready screen stays only for Customize answers that did not all go in
Customize answers that did not all go in
